name: Inou Reiya
source:
[url=/c102313]Yukito[/url]'s friend. The mansion that serves as the setting for this story belongs to his father, the president of a major bank. 
He planned a trip to a remote mountain resort, which would become the starting point of the incident.
He is [url=/c3501]Otoha[/url]'s fiancé, but the two of them are negative about the relationship that was arranged by their parents.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Blue]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]Reiya's true motivation behind inviting the protagonist to his home is to humiliate fellow members of the cursed Inou bloodline, including his own twin brother - Yukito himself. He harbors no care for human life.[/spoiler]
